# p-group subgroup lemma　`lem.p-group-subgroups`
English entry · root `../`
[in graph](../#n=lem.p-group-subgroups)　·　[Chinese page (authoritative)](./lem.p-group-subgroups.md)

## Notes · **draft**
The proof is on the edge `imp.p-group-subgroups`: induct on $|G|$, use the class equation to get $Z(G) \ne \{e\}$, then split into the two cases $HZ(G) < G$ and $HZ(G) = G$.

⭐ Use: induction on $i$ shows that a $p$-group has subgroups of every order $p^{i}$ ($0 \le i \le n$); this is the key step in the "$i < a$ part" of the Sylow existence proof.

⚠ The conclusion fails for general finite groups: in $S_3$, for $H = \langle(12)\rangle$ one has $N_{S_3}(H) = H$, but $S_3$ is not a $p$-group.

> Proofs of the edges are still Chinese only: `proofs/`; the Chinese page remains authoritative.
